rationale.learned_time_plus_quarter_week: Add one quarter of a week to the learned horizon coordinate by editing 256 horizon biases; test delayed response to archived reports.
rationale.learned_time_plus_half_week: Same exact affine weight-space translation by half a week; learned medians and spreads can respond together.
rationale.learned_time_plus_one_week: Same exact translation by one week, testing a stronger timing adjustment.
rationale.learned_time_minus_half_week: Opposite-direction intervention to test whether the decoder instead extrapolates too aggressively.
